newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK's Pegasus flotation to begin on Oct 1 - sources.
newsitem.headline: HK's Pegasus flotation to begin on Oct 1 - sources.

text.p: Flotation of shares of Taiwanese-owned sports shoes manufacturer Pegasus Holdings Ltd is expected to open from October 1 to 4 and dealing in shares is expected to begin on October 11, market sources said.
Sources said the company would issue 180.3 million new shares, or 25 percent of the expanded share capital, at HK$1.08 per share. Yuanta Securities is the sponsor of the issue.

The company which has two manufacturing plants in China's Guangdong, forecast a profit of not less than HK$118 million for the fiscal year ending December 21, 1996, up about 82 percent from 1995 earnings of HK$64.9 million, sources said.

"Proceeds will be used mainly to expand its production facility in China and to add four more production lines to the existing 23 lines," said one analyst who attended the company's briefing on Thursday.
Apart for funding expansion, about HK$39 million of the proceeds will be used to repay bank borrowing and a remaining HK$35 million will be used for working capital, sources added.
Pegasus makes athletic footwear, sports sandals and leisure-wear shoes. Its major custmers incllude Nike, Airwalk, Simple, Teva, Dr Scholl's, Guess and Hang Ten.
Pegasus is scheduled to hold a press briefing on its flotation plan on Monday.
